title: PrismML brings its tiny LLMs to Qualcomm-powered smart glasses | TechCrunch
summary: The AI Lab PrismML — founded by Caltech researchers and advised by UC Berkeley’s Ion Stoica — has created a version of its tiny language models for smart glasses running on Qualcomm’s Snapdragon chips.
